description: 2016 SoE Built Environment Accessibility to public transport, capital cities, 2011 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by State of the Environment. The Metropolitan Accessibility/Remoteness Index of Australia (Metro ARIA), developed by the Hugo Centre for Migration and Population Research (University of Adelaide, previously APMRC) and sponsored by the Australian Urban Research Infrastructure Network (AURIN), provides a nationally consistent and comparable dataset that quantifies geographic accessibility within the metropolitan area. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher State of the Environment. Its tags are 2016, 2016 SoE, Built environment, Built environment Map, SoE. It offers 2 resource(s) in ESRI REST, ESRI SHAPE AND LAYER FILES. The portal shows 2023-08-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
